profiling: QA-only inclusive CPU call wall times; nested stages overlap and must not be summed. No extra GPU synchronization or timer queries. Wrappers are removed after each pass.

reports.note: Actual Game.tick, normal bullets/HP/AI/offered upgrades, explicit dense spawn isolation. Legacy bullet baseline is used only when legacyBulletComparison=true; otherwise both passes retain default bullet rules and onPass controls the renderer experiment. One fixed1/60 tick per render; raf mode waits before every render, batch8 keeps historical eight-render yields. This is a paced fixed-workload comparison: no product-loop catch-up, interpolation, HUD, audio or persistence. Render time is game.time for deterministic camera/shake. Call wall times include instrumentation; combined includes event draining and render. rAF callback intervals include browser scheduling and are not presented FPS or actual GPU execution. QA data stays in memory.
